name: Shuugyou Ryokou ~Koto Meisou Chizu~
original_name: 修業旅行～古都迷走地図～
source:
Nanbu Shouhei lives and attends a high school in Tokyo but in his childhood, he briefly attended kindergarten in Kyoto while living with his mother and maternal side of the family there. 

He started playing an online fantasy RPG called Fang of Ouroboros three years ago and met a player who rescued him when he was a newbie. The other player claimed to be Senke Tomonari, who had been one of his kindergarten classmates in Kyoto. They became close buddies through the game though they never met or talked over the phone but only communicated online because of the distance.

When Nanbu's high school organized a study trip to Kyoto, Nanbu and Senke made a pact to meet up in the flesh since they have not met since their kindergarten days. Nanbu duly appears at the meeting-place arranged by clues from the online game but Senke does not turn up. Instead he keeps getting puzzling mails from Senke and he is assaulted by a bow-gun when touring Kyoto. 

Is the "Senke" Nanbu met online really Nanbu's childhood classmate or an impostor? Who is behind these assaults?

[From [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t96302-review-shuugyou-ryokou-koto.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
translation:
南部章平住在东京并就读高中，幼年时却曾随母亲及外祖家人在京都生活，短暂进入当地幼儿园。

三年前，他开始玩一款名为《Fang of Ouroboros》的在线奇幻RPG，并遇见一名在自己还是新手时出手相救的玩家。对方自称千家友成，是他在京都读幼儿园时的同学。两人通过游戏成为亲密好友，但因距离遥远，从未见面或通电话，只在网上交流。

南部的高中组织京都修学旅行时，两人约定现实见面，毕竟从幼儿园时代以后便再未相逢。南部按照在线游戏提供的线索抵达约定地点，千家却没有出现。相反，他不断收到千家发来的谜样邮件，游览京都时还遭弩箭袭击。

南部在网上遇见的“千家”真是童年同学，还是冒名顶替者？接连袭击又是谁在幕后策划？

[摘自[url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t96302-review-shuugyou-ryokou-koto.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
